parameters.name: BackendBucketRegionId
parameters.description: The region where the gateway cluster resides. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to obtain a valid region ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the gateway cluster list.

Start value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.
